ResetCommands.Comment: Puts scroll of weapon enchantment in desk

Rooms.Name: Credits
Rooms.Description:
Thanks to IO for making the MUD in the first place.  Thanks to Nymph,
for helping us out with supplying us with a sample file.  Also to all the
immortals for helping to make the MUD a better place :)

Rooms.Name: Through a Tiny Cave
Rooms.Description:
As you walk through this dark place you seem to find your equipment
double in size, or is it you getting smaller?

Rooms.Name: Before the Village of Faerise
Rooms.Description:
Far and wide in front of you lies the most beautiful garden you've 
ever seen. Overgrown flowers that resemble homes tower above you. 
This place has a beautiful, magical scent and you decide its a good 
place to visit.

Rooms.Name: Village of Faerise
Rooms.Description:
Home of the most tiniest, most beautiful creatures -- the fairies.
To the east you see a giant sunflower stem that needs to be explored,
and farther north lies a magnificent, miniature lagoon.

Rooms.Name: In Front of a Giant Stem
Rooms.Description:
You look up. Woah. Before you stands the largest, greenest stem you've
ever seen. It makes you dizzy just looking at it.  But when you look
closer you see there are grooves and leaf stems that make it look like an
easy climb. Shall you?

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Stem
Rooms.Description:
You place your feet into the tiny notches along the stem. As you keep 
going, you hope you won't slip and fall to your doom.

Rooms.Name: Climbing the Stem
Rooms.Description:
You are nearing the top of the huge stem. Looking upwards you see a 
huge sunflower petals of vibrant yellow.

Rooms.Name: On Top of a SunFlower
Rooms.Description:
Wiping a drop of sweat from your brow, you take a deep breath. The air 
is crisp and floral, overall, pleasant up here.  The view is overwhelming.
From here you can see the whole village of Faerise, the wonderful gardens,
the beautiful lagoon and all the little fairies playing below. The ground
is soft and light.  There's a trail of sunflower seeds leading to the east.

Rooms.Name: On a SunFlower Petal
Rooms.Description:
The Scent of the flower is overpowering! You can see far over the 
village at this view point. I'd say the climb was worth it? Wouldn't you?

Exits.Description: On the Tippy Top of the Flower

Rooms.Name: Before the Lagoon
Rooms.Description:
Before you lies a miniature lagoon. From here you see the delicate 
ripples of the water, the grassy surroundings and the beautiful fairy 
civilization. No wonder the fairies are such a charming race.

Rooms.Name: A Small Garden
Rooms.Description:
Your nostrils are filled with exotic scents from the many types of 
flowers. Roses, Tulips, Buttercups, you name it, it's here. All the bright 
colors fill your eyes with delight, while the sound of the wind blowing 
through the trees make you feel calm. Looking westward you see a small red 
tulip that has fallen over.

Rooms.Name: Inside a Tulip
Rooms.Description:
You've never really been inside a flower before, so you don't know what
to expect. There's a strong smell of nectar in the area and you're not too
sure if you like it. In fact, its giving you a headache. There's a faint
buzzing too, but it seems to be getting louder. Maybe exploring the flower
wasn't such a good idea.

Rooms.Name: In Front of the Lagoon
Rooms.Description:
Here lies the Lagoon of Faerise. Beautiful to the eye, but you're not
too sure about swimming in it. The lagoon continues to the east and west.

Rooms.Name: South-East Edge of the Lagoon
Rooms.Description: The path around the lagoon continues to the north and to the west.

Rooms.Name: Around the Lagoon
Rooms.Description:
As you keep walking around the lagoon, you notice a small path 
leading to the east.

Rooms.Name: North-East Corner of the Lagoon
Rooms.Description: The path around the lagoon continues to the south and to the west.

Rooms.Name: Beside the Lagoon
Rooms.Description:
Here you can see across the lagoon right to the entrance of Faerise. 
You smile to yourself and decide this was a wonderful experience. To the 
north you see another path leading away from the lagoon, towards a palace 
made of flowers.  To the east and west, the lagoon continues.

Exits.Description: In the dense part of Faerise

Rooms.Name: North-West Edge of the Lagoon
Rooms.Description: The path around the lagoon continues to the east and south.

Rooms.Name: Around the Lagoon
Rooms.Description:
Across the lagoon, eastward, you can see a small path. This path 
continues to the north and south.

Rooms.Name: South-West Corner of the Lagoon
Rooms.Description: The path around the lagoon continues to the north and east.

Rooms.Name: A Small Path
Rooms.Description:
This path made of small stones, lined with tulips and marigolds 
is said to be the way to the Fairy's Sanctuary. It is also said that 
people who enter the Sanctuary never leave feeling the same. Maybe its 
a blessing. Maybe its a curse. You can always turn back.

Rooms.Name: In Front of the Sanctuary
Rooms.Description:
Before you stands a small little temple, the Fairy's Sanctuary. It is
hideous looking from the outside, almost as if it doesn't belong here,
surrounded with such beautiful creatures and magnificent flowers. There is
a door to the east, slightly open. A strange white glow shines from behind
the door.

Rooms.Name: The Sanctuary
Rooms.Description:
Light pours in from all directions, which seems odd because all
the windows have been covered with vines and strange flowers. The only 
visible exit is the way you came in, but there is a small draft coming
in from underneath you.

Rooms.Name: In the dark passage
Rooms.Description: It is damp and cold in here. You'd like to make a hasty exit.

Rooms.Name: In the dense part of Faerise
Rooms.Description:
Fairies are flying in and out from every direction. They seem very
busy, but each has their own delighted expression on their faces. To the
north is the Village Square.

Rooms.Name: Village Square
Rooms.Description:
Small shops line the streets. A florist selling flowers, a magician
selling fine herbs and vials, and a baker selling sweet smelling deserts
are all here smiling at their customers. You see at least a dozen fairies
flittering about.

Exits.Description: In the dense part of the city

Rooms.Name: The Palace Gates
Rooms.Description:
Towering before you, the Palace Gates stand. The gates seem to
be slightly open towards the north, looks like a short cut. And to the
west is a small flowery path.

Rooms.Name: Fairy's Revenge
Rooms.Description:
You think to yourself, 'If I were a fairy where would I be? The
Palace!' But now you realize this was just a trick. Getting your entire
leg stuck in mud you can't get it out. You eventually get really bored and
slit your wrists. Picking on Fairies are ya? That'll teach ya!

Rooms.Name: A Flower Patch
Rooms.Description:
Smells so sweet in here and you feel like you want to stay forever. 
You suddenly remember that that's not why you're here. You secure all your
equipment, and get in one last glance of this beautiful place.

Rooms.Name: In a Bed of Roses
Rooms.Description:
You slash through the thorns and vines of the roses that tower
above you. It seems as if you'd probably would have enjoyed being a little
taller at the moment. Never thought being so little was such hard work.

Rooms.Name: A Path to the Garden Palace
Rooms.Description:
There is a trail of rose petals leading northbound. Beautiful Fairies
flitter about here.

Rooms.Name: Overlooking the Garden Palace
Rooms.Description:
It has been a long journey and you've started to believe that there
is no such thing as the Fairy Palace.  Just some stupid myth that people
talk about to get you here. You start to grovel, when all of a sudden
you have a certain urge to look forward. A smile comes across your lips
as you see the sun peeping out from behind the palace.

Rooms.Name: In Front of the Garden Palace
Rooms.Description:
Still enchanted from your first glimpse of the palace, your feet lead
the way, as your eyes dart around trying to memorize the beauty of the
place.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to the Garden Palace
Rooms.Description:
As you get a closer look at the palace, you notice the fine
craftsmanship and detail that has been put into the making of this fine
structure. The marbleized pillars stretch to the almost limitless ceiling,
in itself highly adorned with golden vines slathering across its vast
surface.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Garden Palace
Rooms.Description:
You stumble somewhat awkwardly as you realize the magnificent size
of the foyer you have just entered. Gazing at the curvaceous walls, you
are totally awed by the flawless beauty of the gorgeous hand-woven 
tapestries. Westward is the exit from the palace and to the east lies
a long hallway.

Rooms.Name: A Long Hallway
Rooms.Description:
Wood carvings of dalecarlian horses, their nostrils flaring, stare at
you in equine amazement. As you progress down the hallway, the walls are
recessed with gleaming golden pedestals bearing exquisitely-shaped crystal
ornaments. The hallway continues westward leading back to the entrance. To
the east lies a turn in the hallway.

Rooms.Name: A Corner
Rooms.Description:
A strong silent sentry suited in silver armor stands sagaciously in the
corner. As you egress down the hallway, shimmering purple pixie dust
descends upon you. Looking south, you get a glimpse of the enchanting
throne room. To the west is a brightly lit hallway.

Rooms.Name: The Throne Room
Rooms.Description:
In the center of the throne room is an incredible pair of pearlized
thrones, encrusted with bedazzling emeralds, rubies, diamonds and
sapphires. This is where King Oberon and Queen Titania rule over their
mystical kingdom.  To the east is Titania's garden. Westward lies Oberon's
study. Looking south, you see a room filled with fragrant flower petals.
North you see a bend in the hallway.

Exits.Description: A Room Filled With Rose Petals

Rooms.Name: Oberon's Study
Rooms.Description:
In the study, the shelves are lined with spell-binding books.  Off to
one side is a massive mahogany desk. An extremely large bay window
spanning one complete wall scatters shimmering shafts of sunlight into all
nooks and crannies. The window is open permitting a billowing breeze to
flow into the room wafting the curtains high into the air.  The only
visible exit is back the way you came.

Rooms.Name: Titania's Personal Garden
Rooms.Description:
An abundance of beautiful blossoms in a rainbow of colours flourishes
in this gorgeous garden. In the centre of the garden is a frolicking
fountain with posing chubby cherubs. While the floral fragrance fills your
nostrils, the profusion of colour seizes your eyes and the cascading water
heightens your awareness. You feel incredibly energized.

Rooms.Name: A Room Filled With Rose Petals
Rooms.Description:
An immediate sense of peace surrounds you when you step into this room.     
The heady aroma of the soft rose petals invades your soul.

Mobs.Name: fairy female
Mobs.LongDescription: A beautiful female Fairy frolics in the flowers here.
Mobs.Description:
The fairy is about 32 centimeters tall and as she notices you she
greets you with a smile.

Mobs.Name: fairy male
Mobs.LongDescription: A male fairy stands here looking for a mate.
Mobs.Description:
He looks strong to you now since you are the same size as him. Probably quite
the adversary too.

Mobs.Name: monk fairy
Mobs.LongDescription: The Monk of Faerise is standing here, chanting a psalm.
Mobs.Description: The Monk looks really wise and omnipotent. He doesn't seem to notice you.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%20 emote mumbles to himself.;%10 emote prays to the powers that be.

Mobs.Name: puck sprite
Mobs.LongDescription: Puck, the mischeivious sprite stands here looking for trouble.
Mobs.Description:
Puck is Oberon's loyal servant. He notices you and smirks. Looks like he has
something in store for you!

Mobs.Name: fairy evil
Mobs.LongDescription: A hideous looking fairy glares at you and attacks.
Mobs.Description:
She is the ugliest fairy you have ever seen. She definitely doesn't seem
to fit in well with the other fairies. Maybe she's an outcast.

Mobs.Name: unicorn female
Mobs.LongDescription: A female unicorn is here, comforting her mate.
Mobs.Description: She is a beautiful creature, but there is a sadness about her.

Mobs.Name: unicorn male
Mobs.LongDescription: A male unicorn with his horn slashed off stands here weeping in pain.
Mobs.Description:
Since his horn has been detached from his body, he looks like a magnificent
white stallion.

Mobs.Name: bee bumble
Mobs.LongDescription: A bumble bee is here gathering pollen.
Mobs.Description: The Bumble Bee looks very angry that you have entered its territory.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%25 emote buzzs loudly making your ears ring.

Mobs.Name: girl gigantic young
Mobs.LongDescription: A gigantic young girl is here, running around trying to catch fairies.
Mobs.Description:
She towers above you. She suddenly looks your way, giggles and starts
swinging her net at you. Maybe you shouldn't have bothered her.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 emote hums happily, swinging her net.;%10 emote exclaims, 'My, you're an ugly fairy!'

Mobs.Name: servant fairy woman
Mobs.LongDescription: A servant of the king and queen fairies dusts happily here.
Mobs.Description:
She looks like a very pleasant woman. She hums quietly as she works, seems
to like her job.

Mobs.Name: titania queen fairy
Mobs.LongDescription: Titania the beautiful queen of fairies sits here on her throne.
Mobs.Description:
Titania is the most beautiful fairy you've ever laid eyes on. She smiles
sweetly at you.

Mobs.Name: oberon king fairy
Mobs.LongDescription: Oberon the handsome king of the fairies sits here admiring his queen.
Mobs.Description:
Oberon looks very charming, his smile is broad and his body is built.
He seems very fond of the lovely lady sitting beside him.

Objects.Name: horn unicorn fairy
Objects.Description: A horn lies here, vibrating power.

Objects.Name: magic mushroom fairy
Objects.Description: A glowing mushroom is growing here.

Objects.Name: cup holy grail fairy
Objects.Description: A golden, jewel encrusted grail is sitting here, glowing.

Objects.Name: key rose fairy
Objects.Description: A key that is shaped like a rose is here.

Objects.Name: loincloth mystical mystic fairy^
Objects.Description: A strip of cloudy cloth levitates here.

Objects.Name: rose diamond fairy
Objects.Description: A magnificent diamond rose lies here glinting light around the room.

Objects.Name: leggings luminous fairy
Objects.Description: A pair of leggings lie here, giving off light.

Objects.Name: desk mahogany fairy
Objects.Description: Oberon's mahogany desk sits here in the corner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Oberon's desk looks amazingly well crafted. He must have had the best
carpenter in all of Faerise to make it.

Objects.Name: scroll enchant enchantment weapon fairy
Objects.Description: A scroll that reads 'nopeaw tnahcne' lies here.

Objects.Name: fountain fairy
Objects.Description: A cascading multi-tiered fountain splashes crystal-clear water here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This fountain sprays beautiful mists of water in the air and has a small 
cherub on the top.
